CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeTool.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset
CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeTool.description: Cubeless native editor diagnostics, asset verification and compiler operations. Never reference this editor class from game assets.

tools.description:
Read imported skeletal mesh sections for one LOD, including enabled state and source section identity.
SkeletalMeshPath is an object path such as /Game/Meshes/SK_Test.SK_Test; LODIndex is zero-based.
Returns JSON matching the legacy GetSections data fields plus operation status. Loads the mesh but never edits or saves it.
If mesh compilation is pending, returns a retryable read error instead of forcing synchronous compilation.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.GetSkeletalMeshSections

tools.description: Return JSON with engine/project identity, dirty packages, PIE state and MCP plugin state. Does not save, compile, close, or modify assets.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.GetEditorDiagnostics

tools.description:
Compile a Blueprint and return JSON with actual compiler errors, warnings and tokenized messages.
BlueprintPath is the asset object path. Optional node refresh occurs before compilation; optional save occurs only after compilation passes.
This mutates compiler/generated-class state, is not atomic, and never retries or rolls back. Rejects PIE/SIE.
A successful compile is not proof of runtime behavior or a reload; see saved and validation_scope separately.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.CompileBlueprintValidation

tools.description:
Audit saved package dependencies for Cubeless, legacy MCP, official MCP, Toolset Registry, Python and EditorScriptingUtilities references.
PackageNames are long package names such as /Game/Tests/BP_Test, without object suffixes.
Includes hard and soft package references. Optional recursion has a strict MaxPackages budget (1..4096).
Returns JSON containing edges, violations, incomplete reasons and dirty packages. Incomplete scans never pass.
Saved Asset Registry data only: not proof of unsaved object references, all possible editor-only classes, or plugin-free packaging.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.AuditPackageDependencies

tools.description:
Refresh nodes if requested, compile and collect native diagnostics; save only after successful compilation.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Full /Game package/object path, or bare name under /Game/Blueprints.
            save: Save on successful compile; defaults to legacy False.
            refresh_nodes: Refresh all nodes before compile; defaults to legacy True and may change graph serialization.
            operation_id: Durable request ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Inspect a prior interrupted mutation before retry.

tools.description:
Create a Blueprint without overwriting, explicit compile, or save. Parent must resolve; known MCP/editor-tool parent chains are rejected.

        Args:
            name: New asset name. Use a single identifier, not a path.
            parent_class: Native class name (Actor/Pawn etc.) or full native/generated class path; empty means Actor.
            package_path: Directory under /Game; defaults to /Game/Blueprints (explicit empty also uses that legacy default). No object suffix.
            operation_id: Unique request ID for durable replay protection. Omitted/null generates an ID returned in the result. Reuse only with identical arguments.

        Returns:
            Structured result. data_json includes name, path, asset_path and actual parent; creation remains unsaved.
